--- stdout
rea mcp doctor — Validate MCP adapter startup and tool listing

Usage: rea mcp doctor [options]

Options:
  --format <toon|json|yaml|md|jsonl>  Output format
  --json                              Emit the report as JSON
  --full-output                       Show the full output envelope
  --help, -h                          Show help

Checks this REA adapter using the current runtime; does not verify a client's registered command or launch environment. This entry accepts only the options above.
